description: This file manages backup rotation, permission hardening, and cleanup for configuration files, including functions to rotate backups, set permissions, remove orphan backups, and run the full backup maintenance cycle.

methods.name: rotateConfigBackups
methods.description: Rotates backup files for a given configuration path, shifting existing backups and creating space for a new backup.

methods.name: hardenBackupPermissions
methods.description: Sets permission mode to owner-only (0o600) on all backup files to enhance security.

methods.name: cleanOrphanBackups
methods.description: Removes backup files outside the managed rotation ring that are considered orphaned.

methods.name: maintainConfigBackups
methods.description: Runs the full backup maintenance cycle: rotation, copying, permission hardening, and cleanup.
